note: v1 95.80 (seeds 0/11 95.80/95.92), first draft of the AMBIENT / HALF-TIME INTERLUDE, 'Underpass': the album's breath between Hairline and Overpass Rain - walking through an underpass at night with the city's drum & bass heard through concrete. A dark wobbly grand and a stretched-voice pad walk from G minor down to F minor (ending on Fm9 for Overpass Rain); the amen plays only in two half-time sections, kick on the one and snare on the three; and where the beat is not, the whole amen is fed silently through wM's granular cloud and a long hall, so the next room's music is smeared into the walls while a low voice drifts. The second half-time adds a glass bell. No roll, no skip, no fracture. (Draft 1 ran the smeared echoes everywhere and measured as one long sameness, 76; giving them only the beatless sections made the shape.) Levels: -13.0 LUFS, true peak -1.0 dBTP, run 2.
